title: C/C++ Native Library Integration & Leaf Evaluation Report
reason: L6 profiling identified no pure Python CPU leaf hotspots or mandatory native library requirements; introducing C/C++ FFI wrappers increases memory safety and ABI risk without producing measurable application-level performance gains.

evaluatedNativeCandidates.candidate: C/C++ PDFium / Poppler Native C-API Extraction Leaf

contract.lifecycle: Explicit allocation via pdfium_init(), page extraction, and c_free_buffer() deallocation

safetyRisks: Unsafe raw pointer buffer management and potential use-after-free without strict lifetime bounds
Lack of AddressSanitizer (ASan) and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (UBSan) in standard build environment
Segfault risk on malformed or corrupted PDF binary streams crashing the host process tree
evaluatedNativeCandidates.rationale: PyMuPDF/fitz already uses compiled native bindings; a custom C/C++ FFI wrapper adds zero performance advantage while introducing process-level memory corruption vulnerabilities.

evaluatedNativeCandidates.candidate: C/C++ Tesseract C-API OCR Image Leaf

contract.lifecycle: TessBaseAPIInit3() initialization and TessBaseAPEnd() cleanup per worker thread

safetyRisks: Thread-safety constraints in legacy C API global state initialization
Cross-platform C runtime (MSVC vs GCC/Clang) ABI incompatibility across Windows x64 / ARM64 targets
Memory leak risks during malformed image buffer parsing
evaluatedNativeCandidates.rationale: OCR processing duration is dominated by neural layout analysis and Tesseract engine inference; C FFI transit overhead offsets minor C++ execution savings.

safetyAndAuditEvidence.asanUbsanStatus: UNAVAILABLE (Native C/C++ compiler toolchain not present on build runner)
safetyAndAuditEvidence.abiStability: HIGH_RISK (Requires maintaining MSVC / MinGW dynamic lib loading and C-ABI exported symbols)
safetyAndAuditEvidence.isolationMechanism: Process isolation via Python worker subprocess (prevents core Tauri host crash)

verdict.action: Halt C/C++ native leaf integration; enforce 100% Python/Tauri fallback behavior and rely on worker process recycling per L6 scorecard recommendations.
